title: Japan's Amazake Becoming Popular as a Health Drink
paragraphs: A traditional sweet drink called amazake is becoming increasingly popular across Japan for its health benefits. Once seen mainly as a sweet, warm drink for the winter, amazake is now being promoted as a drink that can be enjoyed hot or cold all year round. And it may be about to go global!
Amazake means "sweet sake" in Japanese — but it actually contains little or no alcohol, depending on how it's made.

There are two types of amazake. One type, sake kasu amazake, is made with sake lees — called kasu in Japanese — which is the solid mass left over from the rice and other ingredients used to make sake. This type of amazake is made by mixing the lees with hot water and sugar, and it contains trace amounts of alcohol.

The other type, koji amazake, is a fermented mix of rice, water and malted rice, which is called koji in Japanese. This drink is naturally sweet, needing no extra sugar, and contains no alcohol at all.

Koji amazake is seen as being particularly healthy because it contains probiotics — bacteria and yeasts that are good for gut health. It also has many types of vitamin B — including vitamin B2, which is good for your skin, hair and nails — as well as amino acids that are also good for the skin, and lots of glucose, which gives you extra energy.

Koji amazake is increasingly being promoted as a cold drink that can help keep people hydrated in summer. According to The Yomiuri Shimbun, an amazake vending machine was even installed in June in a childcare center in the famously hot city of Kumagaya in Saitama prefecture.

And Ferment Base, a new company based in the city of Utsunomiya in Tochigi prefecture, has been promoting the health benefits of amazake abroad. The company has developed a smoother, lighter type of amazake, which it believes will appeal more to foreign tastes. The company made its amazake available at some California supermarkets in January.
